partial_formalization.current_density_identification: The actual inverse-defined density equation is complexified and Fourier transformed using proved L1 integrability and the convolution theorem, with exact conversion between angular and Mathlib frequency conventions. Hyperbolic algebra and proved nonvanishing give its actual transform 1/(2*cosh(lambda*p/2)). The displayed profile has the same transform, is continuous and integrable, and its transform is integrable. Fourier inversion proves pointwise fullLineDensityFunction(lambda,u)=1/(2*lambda*cosh(u/(lambda/pi))) for every 0<lambda<pi and every real u.
partial_formalization.current_exponential_deficit_rate: The identified actual density satisfies exp(-Q/(lambda/pi))/(2*lambda)<=r(Q)<=exp(-Q/(lambda/pi))/lambda for every Q>=0 and every 0<lambda<pi. Combining this with the checked boundary-value deficit comparison proves c*exp(-Q/(lambda/pi))<=1/2-M_Q<=C*exp(-Q/(lambda/pi)) uniformly for Q>=0 in the strict negative-kernel regime pi/2<lambda<pi. The finite-window positive-kernel counterpart remains open.
partial_formalization.remaining: Whole Lemma3.1 remains partial. The positive consecutive-momentum Slater state is now proved to be the ACTUAL free spin-sector Hamiltonian eigenvector and its simple ground-state line,with the lower energy bound for every complex sector vector. The full spin-coordinate action,all sorted boundary maps and blocked collision cases are complete. Still identify the actual ABA Bethe vector with that ground line by its coordinate formula or exact Hamiltonian energy,then justify continuation in lambda. The actual transfer-eigenline logarithmic derivative has now been proved for this purpose. The canonical actual Hamiltonian-ground/transfer-Perron certificate remains proved. U09 keeps the occupied compact-test qualification. No Bethe Perron conclusion is claimed.
partial_formalization.uniform_finite_window_comparison: Actual Fubini associativity for L1 kernels and a bounded measurable right factor covers the exterior indicator. It proves the exterior-resolvent operator identity and rewrites the existing finite-window inverse as a genuine fixed point. Its operator norm is at most the actual resolvent L1 mass. Positive Neumann comparison and an explicit supersolution prove r<=r_Q<=r/(1-tau) on every window, including endpoints, and 1/(1+h)<=H_Q<=1, for 0<lambda<pi/2. Combined with the checked negative-K and free cases, exists_uniform_finiteInterval_comparison proves constants c,C>0, depending only onlambda and chosen before all Q>=0 and abs(u)<=Q, with c*r<=r_Q<=C*r and c<=H_Q<=C for every 0<lambda<pi.
partial_formalization.all_physical_filling_mass_and_cutoffs: Combining the two signs of K and the free point, the actual M_Q is strictly increasing on Q>=0, M_0=0, 0<M_Q<1/2 for every finite Q>0, and M_Q tends to1/2. Every prescribed filling rho in(0,1/2) has exactly one actual nonnegative cutoff; every family of masses converging strictly below one half has eventually bounded cutoffs. All statements hold for every 0<lambda<pi.
partial_formalization.all_physical_exponential_deficit: The actual full-line exterior mass is between exp(-Q/(lambda/pi))/pi and twice that expression for Q>=0, by the identified density, evenness and actual exponential integration. The ordinary finite-window deficit is comparable to that exterior mass in both parameter regimes. Consequently the exact manuscript rate c*exp(-Q/(lambda/pi))<=1/2-M_Q<=C*exp(-Q/(lambda/pi)) is proved for every 0<lambda<pi, with positive constants chosen before every cutoff, including the free point.
partial_formalization.all_physical_reference_quadrature_and_ga: The original scaled reference Gaudin operator equals identity plus the actual kernel row operator and actual diagonal density error. The proved all-physical bounds give a uniform convergent Neumann inverse once the actual scaled density exceeds a fixed threshold. Both inverse identities and the norm bound are checked. Uniform finite-window comparison supplies that threshold on bounded cutoffs as chain length grows,and under one full-line boundary criterion L*r(Q)>=D even for unbounded cutoffs. The actual reference Gaudin matrix is nonsingular at sufficiently dense bounded-cutoff reference data. This does not yet prove positive-K on-shell root construction or stability of the Jacobian under nonlinear perturbation.
partial_formalization.all_physical_actual_ordered_roots_and_de: The actual continuum profile has an exponential lower bound on the expanded occupied window. For a sufficiently large fixed scaled-density threshold,the actual perturbed counting derivative is positive there. Consecutive target levels therefore force strict ordering of the constructed solutions. The actual roots obey a uniform weighted quantile bound and an O(1) counting-density error on the entire real line. Uniform finite-window comparison translates the threshold into the manuscript boundary criterion L*r(Q)>=D,even when Q diverges. Every constant precedes the finite data.
partial_formalization.all_physical_regular_root_branches_and_c: A convergent Neumann correction of the actual reference right inverse proves nonsingularity of the original actual Gaudin matrix throughout a sufficiently small weighted configuration neighborhood. The actual ordered roots and uniform density error are assembled with this nonsingularity for every physical lambda. Under the manuscript boundary-density criterion,these actual roots have real-analytic twist branches and the exact Gaudin response identity at every sufficiently nearby twist. No determinant premise or inverse is assumed for the constructed roots. The actual scattering phase derivative and absolute-kernel comparison prove relative phase increments for both kernel signs. Actual weighted root closeness then gives a whole-line counting-phase displacement bound. Combined with actual reference quadrature,this proves uniform discrepancy from the actual finite-window cumulative density,including bounded counting extensions at both endpoints. A single actual-root assembler supplies ordered roots,weighted displacement,whole-line density and primitive errors,and the actual nonsingular Gaudin matrix with all constants chosen before the finite data. Actual finite mass data construct their own reference mid-quantiles and nonsingular ordered roots. Every family whose boundary density times chain length diverges has eventual actual roots with uniform weighted displacement and counting-density error. The bounded-cutoff alternative is uniform over all sufficiently large chains. The explicit c*L^a boundary lower bound with c,a positive implies the dense-boundary criterion. At every limiting filling below half,actual cutoff boundedness is derived from the finite-window mass limit,and the resulting n/L family has eventual roots. These results cover every physical lambda and use the actual manuscript density and finite equations.
partial_formalization.all_physical_actual_measure_quadrature: A genuine transport estimate compares the actual inverse-counting-density measure with the reference weighted atoms. It retains the individual root weights and an arbitrary positive fixed enlargement of the support,so its rate uses the local rather than the global density scale. Combining reference quadrature and transport proves C/N times(Lip(phi)+norm(phi)) for tests supported inside the reference occupied interval. The local scale can be the actual counting density once N exceeds a fixed finite threshold. The corresponding filtered local convergence to Lebesgue measure is checked for varying finite root counts under the proved weighted-neighborhood and density hypotheses.
partial_formalization.joint_actual_root_measure_families: PhysicalRootMeasureData records genuine properties of one actual root list:ConsecutiveRoots,weighted quantile displacement,whole-line density error,original Gaudin determinant nonzero,positive actual atom weights,uniform actual unit-interval mass,a real-analytic twist branch with exact Gaudin response,and the all-positive-N actual quadrature bound. Its witnesses are constructed from the previously proved actual root,inverse and measure estimates;none of its fields is introduced as an external assumption. A single larger fixed density threshold guarantees all fields for the same X. The manuscript boundary-density criterion and actual finite mass data then construct the reference quantiles and this same actual X. The joint construction gives actual root-measure families under the dense-boundary criterion. A stronger selection theorem chooses the reference and actual roots once,before every test-window length and enlargement. For every fixed length and positive enlargement,uniform eventual measure,quadrature and analytic-branch conclusions hold for those same chosen roots. The corresponding filtered local convergence to Lebesgue measure is proved for their actual atomic measures,with varying finite root counts. The earlier regular-filling and positive-power boundary criteria supply the density hypothesis.
partial_formalization.actual_row_logarithmic_hamiltonian_parti: The actual complex derivative of physicalR at zero is proved. Multiplication by the swap and negative real scale gives the explicit local six-matrix,opposite-spin hopping -eta/sin(lambda),strict negativity throughout 0<lambda<pi for eta>0,and Hermiticity. The product rule is proved for the existing ordered finite row contraction and its marked auxiliary trace. It gives the genuine derivative of the actual homogeneous transfer row at the swap,whose value is the cyclic translation. The actual logarithmic Hamiltonian uses the explicit inverse translation. Its entries agree with the scalar derivatives of the actual row entries. Actual homogeneous physical rows commute at every complex spectral coordinate. Differentiating their entrywise finite product sums proves that the actual row derivative commutes with every row. The explicit inverse translation also commutes with every row,hence so does the actual logarithmic Hamiltonian. No Perron or local-sum identity is assumed. The genuine ordered row derivative equals the finite sum of single-site tile insertions,retaining both auxiliary boundary spins and site order. Auxiliary tracing and inverse translation preserve this formula. The first insertion is contracted exactly:it acts on the last and first physical spins and fixes every intervening spin. For the actual R derivative it is exactly the local physical link operator on that periodic seam.
partial_formalization.full_actual_link_hamiltonian_and_sector_: Splitting the existing row contraction at its final site proves invariance of the auxiliary trace under simultaneous cyclic rotation of the physical spins and tile list. Actual translation conjugation moves every interior insertion to the preceding site. Iteration identifies every insertion as a translated first insertion. The genuine logarithmic row derivative therefore equals the full cyclic sum of the explicit last-first physical link operator. The explicit seam matrix is proved Hermitian. Its unitary translation conjugates remain Hermitian,so the actual full logarithmic Hamiltonian is Hermitian. This uses the actual previously defined row derivative and translation,with no assumed Hamiltonian identity. AdjacentSpinSwap is the concrete nearest-neighbor exchange of opposite binary spins at an arbitrary adjacent pair. Such exchanges preserve minusCount. A constructive proof moves an occupied spin to the front and proves that every two RowSpins configurations with the same particle number are joined by a finite sequence of these exchanges. This establishes combinatorial sector connectivity. Identifying every such exchange with a strictly negative entry of the actual full Hamiltonian remains a separate obligation. The physical local link and explicit seam have real entries and nonpositive off-diagonal entries for 0<lambda<pi and eta>=0. Powers of actual permutation matrices are proved to rotate both matrix configurations exactly. The cyclic-sum identity then proves that the actual full logarithmic Hamiltonian has real entries and nonpositive off-diagonal entries. The actual translation preserves minusCount,as do all its iterates. The seam link vanishes between different particle counts;hence so does the actual full Hamiltonian. It maps every previously defined SpinSector into itself. For eta>0 an opposite-spin exchange at the first two sites has a strictly negative entry in the actual full Hamiltonian:one explicit translated bond is negative and the remaining off-diagonal terms cannot cancel it. Cyclic invariance of the actual Hamiltonian transfers the strict first-pair hopping sign to every adjacent pair. The proof keeps the swap position,decreases it by rotating a leading spin to the end,and applies induction. The graph is then defined by distinct vertices in one exact particle sector and strict negativity of the actual full Hamiltonian entry. Its symmetry follows from actual Hermiticity,and its preconnectedness follows by lifting the proved adjacent-swap paths. No graph-connectivity or strict-hopping assumption is introduced.
partial_formalization.actual_positive_simple_sector_minimum: Every allowed particle count has a concrete RowSpins configuration. The exact real restriction of the actual logarithmic Hamiltonian is Hermitian. Applying the proved finite minimum theorem to this restriction and the actual strict-negative-entry hopping graph gives a strictly positive simple minimum in every valid particle sector,for every 0<lambda<pi and eta>0. The lower energy bound holds for every real vector in that sector. The exact complex sector restriction equals the scalar embedding of the proved real matrix. Real eigenvectors embed exactly,and splitting a complex eigenvector into real and imaginary parts proves that the entire complex eigenspace at the minimum is one-dimensional. The exact complex Hermitian quadratic energy splits into the two real coordinate energies. The real lower bound therefore gives the full complex lower energy bound with sum of squared complex norms. The actual complex sector Hamiltonian has a positive real ground vector and a simple complex ground eigenspace.
partial_formalization.canonical_actual_sector_transfer_perron_: PhysicalSectorPerronData is constructed for every 0<lambda<pi,eta>0 and valid particle sector. It includes the actual Hamiltonian lower energy bound and ground eigenvector, a strictly positive transfer eigenvalue, the bound for every complex eigenvalue, the whole simple complex eigenspace and actual transfer primitivity. The canonical vector is constructed by the earlier ground-state existence theorem; no Perron input is assumed.
partial_formalization.actual_free_slater_candidate: The site-phase difference has an exact sine factorization. The ordered-pair phase sum counts each coordinate n-1 times,so all configuration-dependent phases cancel. The actual consecutive-root Slater determinant equals one nonzero constant depending only on n times the real sine Vandermonde. Dividing by this single constant makes every ordered configuration within one period real and strictly positive. This constructs the positive candidate used in the free-point argument;the actual spin-operator and Bethe identifications remain open.
partial_formalization.actual_free_spin_hopping_and_coordinate_: The nested physical spin words are explicitly equivalent to Fin L site-bit functions. The actual particle count equals the sum of site bits and the cardinality of the occupied-site set. Its increasing enumeration gives strictly increasing integer coordinates in[0,L). The earlier positive free Slater construction therefore defines an actual spin-sector vector with real,strictly positive amplitudes and a proved nonzero value. Arbitrary site permutations preserve the actual particle count. All9 formerly prepared coordinate results are integrated once. An exchange between an occupied site and an adjacent hole preserves order of the occupied-site enumeration. The exact integer coordinate map of the actual exchanged spin configuration is Function.update at the corresponding particle index by +1 or -1. Order preservation uses the missing target site explicitly;the formulas do not assume the desired Hamiltonian identity. The first-pair link matrix equals an exact translate of the seam term in the actual logarithmic Hamiltonian. At lambda=pi/2 and eta=1/2 the actual local R-derived link has only particle-hole exchange entries,equal to -1/2. Its full-spin matrix action is exactly that exchange when the two spins differ,and zero otherwise. Every actual Hamiltonian bond is the first physical bond evaluated on rotated configurations. Reindexing the finite matrix sum proves the FULL row-derived Hamiltonian acts by the sum of its allowed periodic spin exchanges,each with coefficient -1/2. These are exact operator statements for all spin vectors. All rotations and exchanges preserve the actual particle count. Appending a physical last spin is exactly Fin.snoc of the site-bit tuple. The actual cyclicSpinTranslation is precisely finRotate of the same finite site bits,including its endpoint. The identity is proved for every translation power and every actual spin configuration. A coordinate permutation multiplies the plane-wave determinant by its exact permutation sign. Moving a single particle by one full spatial period multiplies it by (-1)^(particle_count-1),using the actual consecutive-root circle condition. Moving the first particle once around the circle and cyclically putting it last has no sign:these two proved factors cancel. No periodic-boundary sign is assumed. Extending a particle-sector vector by zero turns the exact restricted Hamiltonian action into the full actual physical action. The actual periodic bond exchanges restrict to the same sector. Applying the proved full action gives the exact allowed-exchange sum for the actual complex sector Hamiltonian,without assuming a coordinate-operator or eigenvector identity. The actual bond-rotation permutation is tracked on the actual finite site-bit tuple. Bond k connects precisely the literal sites k-1 and k modulo L. Every actual physical bond exchange is exactly the corresponding site transposition. The full actual Hamiltonian therefore has an explicit site-hopping formula:sum over k of -1/2 times the vector at the swapped configuration when the site bits differ. This is an exact identity for the row-derived operator,not a replacement model.
partial_formalization.actual_free_slater_ground_line: A physical left boundary exchange removes the first occupied coordinate at zero and appends the empty final spatial site. The reverse right exchange prepends zero and removes the final occupied coordinate. Both exact sorted-coordinate maps are proved from the actual occupied-site enumeration. Combining them with the proved fermionic cyclic-wrap cancellation gives the exact covering-line Slater amplitude for both physical boundary exchanges. The3 formerly prepared boundary-coordinate results are integrated once. The occupied index at spatial zero must be the first particle index,and the occupied index at the final spatial site must be the last. These facts combine the proved interior and boundary formulas into one exact Slater amplitude for every allowed left or right physical particle-hole exchange. The increasing occupied-site enumeration is a genuine finite sum correspondence. The actual complex sector Hamiltonian first has the exact literal-site formula and then is reindexed into one left and one right move per occupied particle. The proof explicitly splits the two possible unequal site bits and uses the exact site-swap symmetry and periodic reindexing. Empty sectors are included. No coordinate-Hamiltonian correspondence is assumed. Every occupied physical site has a particle index. Moving one labeled coordinate onto another gives an exactly zero determinant. A plus or minus full-period shift preserves this zero by the actual consecutive-root circle condition. Consequently every blocked right or left move gives zero,including a move across the periodic seam. Spatial length at least2 is explicit. Allowed-hop amplitudes and blocked zeros identify the ACTUAL complex spin-sector Hamiltonian action on the constructed Slater state with the proved free coordinate Hamiltonian action. Applying the already proved determinant eigenvalue theorem gives the actual spin-sector eigenvector equation with energy equal to the sum of -cos(p_j). Every physical bond,periodic boundary and collision case is proved. Two strictly positive eigenvectors of a finite real symmetric matrix have the same eigenvalue,proved by the positive dot product and symmetry. The real part of the constructed Slater vector satisfies the exact real-sector eigenvalue equation. Comparing it with the previously constructed actual positive minimum proves that its energy is the actual ground energy. The complete complex energy lower bound and simple entire complex eigenspace are proved for this specific Slater state. This is the Slater ground line;the ABA Bethe-vector identification is still open. An exact finite matrix eigenline is differentiated entry by entry. A proved algebraic logarithmic-derivative lemma uses the actual inverse translation and nonzero eigenmatrix to show that the transfer eigenvalue at the swap is nonzero and that the actual Hamiltonian eigenvalue is -eta*rho_prime(0)/rho(0). The actual homogeneousPhysicalRow derivative and homogeneousLinkHamiltonian definitions instantiate this identity. The remaining Bethe energy calculation can therefore use the existing entire physical Bethe eigenmatrix directly.
